properties.name: BL1033
properties.notes: Allocation CR12a in Local Plan. This site will be developed for a mix of edge-of-centre retail uses, which may include bulky goods, and residential development, along with public car parking. The retail may include bulky goods, but should not include a significant element of non-bulky comparison goods retail, and must be designed to mesh into the urban fabric and a single storey retail warehouse will not be permitted.. https://images.reading.gov.uk/2019/12/Local_Plan_Adopted_November_2019.pdf
properties.site-address: Cattle Market, Great Knollys Street, Reading
